scope: Independent actual fixed CUT/TRIM recorded-state task and control audit

task_score.scope: Offline oracle task metrics; no runtime, robot, camera or calibrated-fracture acceptance

metrics.mass_scope: Recorded immutable reference-mass vector and aligned particle counts, not framewise mass measurements
metrics.component_provenance: Recomputed actual eight-node compatibility graph including positive weights, stress gradients and code-zero bridges

mechanical_graph.provenance: Recomputed current compatible reference-node MPM graph from recorded actual nodes, weights, stress gradients and cut codes

tracking.active_source: Recorded actually armed material intervals, aligned to their ending robot sample

joints.parked_scope: Measured throughout episode; no new acceptance threshold is fitted to these outcomes

asset_joint_limit_check.scope: Runtime joint-limit tensors and a readable composed USD are unavailable

postwithdraw_motion.scope: Final graph memberships used only retrospectively for COMs; no minimum-motion task requirement or cross-component recontact claim

contact_and_numerical_screens.native_rigid_contact_coverage: All recorded native substeps plus boundaries

missing_controls: Time/grid convergence and calibrated material fracture

reaction.contact_scope: Actual retained MPM event counters; pair counters include within-component events and do not prove recontact. Work is a partitioned interface diagnostic, not total energy convergence.
